tool_arguments.query: AWS AI workload contribution growth Q2 2026 Amazon comment AI revenue

events.content: AWS AI workload contribution growth Q2 2026 Amazon comment AI revenue

- **AWS growth:** AWS revenue was **$42.2 billion in Q2 2026**, up **36.7% year over year**—its fastest growth in 18 quarters—and Amazon said the business reached a **$169 billion annualized revenue run rate**. [[1]]

- **AI-revenue disclosure:** Amazon said AWS’s **AI business exceeded a $25 billion annual revenue run rate** and was growing at a **triple-digit year-over-year rate**; this equates to more than **$6.25 billion on a simple quarterly run-rate basis** and at least roughly **15% of AWS’s $169 billion annualized revenue**, although Amazon did not formally disclose quarterly AI revenue or its precise share of AWS growth. [[1]]

- **Management’s key comment on workload contribution:** Andy Jassy said AWS was seeing strong growth in both **AI** and **non-AI (“core”)** workloads, with each supporting the other rather than AI being an isolated revenue stream. [[2]]

- **Mechanism:** Management said AI adoption encourages customers to move to AWS and increases core-service consumption; moreover, post-training reinforcement learning and AI-agent tool use are largely CPU-intensive, benefiting AWS core compute as well as AI accelerators. [[3]]

- **Important caveat:** Therefore, it would be inaccurate to attribute all—or a defined portion—of the 36.7% AWS growth rate to AI: Amazon disclosed rapid AI revenue growth, but **did not quantify AI’s percentage-point contribution** to Q2 AWS growth. [[3, 1]]

Sources:
[S3.1] Amazon.com, Inc. - Amazon.com Announces Second Quarter Results — https://ir.aboutamazon.com/news-release/news-release-details/2026/Amazon-com-Announces-Second-Quarter-Results/
[S3.2] Amazon.com, Inc. (AMZN) Q2 FY2026 earnings call transcript — https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/AMZN/earnings/AMZN-Q2-2026-earnings_call-657334.html
[S3.3] Amazon (AMZN) Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript — https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/08/07/amazon-amzn-q2-2026-earnings-call-transcript/

tool_arguments.query: Microsoft Azure segment revenue growth Q3 2025 Microsoft earnings AI contribution

events.content: Microsoft Azure segment revenue growth Q3 2025 Microsoft earnings AI contribution

Microsoft’s fiscal Q3 2025, ended March 31, 2025, saw **Azure and other cloud services revenue grow 33% year over year** on a reported basis, or **35% in constant currency**. [[1]] 

AI services contributed **16 percentage points** of that 33% Azure growth—meaning AI was responsible for nearly half of the reported year-over-year growth rate. [[2]] 

For context, Microsoft’s broader Intelligent Cloud segment generated **$26.75 billion** of revenue, up **21% year over year**, while Microsoft Cloud revenue was **$42.4 billion**, up **20%**. [[1]] 

Microsoft also said that scaling AI infrastructure pressured cloud profitability: Intelligent Cloud gross-margin percentage declined despite gross margin increasing $1.9 billion, and cloud/AI engineering investment lifted operating expenses. [[2]]

Sources:
[S4.1] FY25 Q3 - Press Releases - Investor Relations - Microsoft — https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/investor/earnings/fy-2025-q3/press-release-webcast
[S4.2] FY25 Q3 - Intelligent Cloud Performance - Investor Relations - Microsoft — https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/investor/earnings/fy-2025-q3/intelligent-cloud-performance

AWS AI business exceeded a $25 billion annual revenue run rate (~$6.25B quarterly), roughly 15% of the $169 billion annualized run rate, but Amazon did not quantify AI’s percentage-point contribution to the 36.7% growth rate.

Sources: Amazon Q2 2026 earnings release/transcript (S3.1–S3.3); Microsoft FY25 Q3 press release and Intelligent Cloud performance page (S4.1–S4.2).
